text:
mira: Heads-up — bringing q8b-int3 to staging today for a short bring-up eval. We need a curated promptset + golden expansion that stresses long-context, code snippets, and paraphrase robustness.

mira: Thinking: 2k sampling target, 15% longctx (>2k tokens), 10% code, 5% multi-turn. Also ~500 golden examples for regression gating.

alex: q: do we reuse the q6b holdouts or carve fresh holdouts?

mira: prefer fresh holdouts from the new ingest window to catch recent drift. reuse canonical golden only where semantically identical.

sam: labeler capacity FYI: we can do ~400 gold/day if we allocate 4 annotators. If we need faster, we should drop fraction or run a micro-gold triage.

jordan: For dedupe, i'd run both fingerprint and semantic cluster dedupe. Recommend pipeline: sha1 fingerprint -> fuzzyhash -> embedding sim cluster (cosine>0.92) -> keep representative.

jordan: quick SQL I used to sample seeds:```sql
-- sample longctx + code heavy examples
SELECT id, text, length(text) as len, has_code
FROM prompt_bank
WHERE created_at > '2026-02-01'
ORDER BY random()
LIMIT 5000;
```

kai: +1 on embedding cluster. Also add tokenized-prefix dedupe for conversational starts to avoid near-duplicates that differ only in trailing context.

labelops-bot: NOTE: label queue ETA 3 days to onboard golden set if spec is final. Use `/golden create q8b-staging-2026-03` to start.

mira: Spec draft for annotators (short):
- Task: rate response correctness given model answer + reference.
- Labels: PASS / SMALL_ISSUE / MAJOR_ISSUE / HALLUCINATION
- Mark canonical answer variant (text) and highlight hallucinated spans with timestamps.
- For code: run quick lint and flag runtime-syntax errors as MAJOR_ISSUE.
- Ambiguous Qs: escalate to second annotator and flag for triage.

sam: Can we include an eval harness script that automates the baseline comparison? I can drop a prototype.

mira: yes please — we want automated diff on: token-level latency, top-1 accuracy on golden, rerank AUC, and hallucination rate. Also collect failure traces for any MAJOR_ISSUE.

alex: gating thresholds proposed: top-1 accuracy >= baseline - 1.5% AND hallucination_rate <= baseline + 0.5% for canary to pass. If either fails, fallback to model variant.

jordan: FYI quant experiments: q8b-int3 settings we want to try in staging: int3 w/ per-channel scaling + kv-compression on longctx. Watch for subtle tokenization regressions (esp: punctuation runs).

kai: Add small synthetic attacks to golden: repeated prompt shims, truncated context, and code injection cases. Those caught a lot of regressions last bring-up.

mira: OK owners:
- curation/dedupe pipeline: jordan + kai
- golden spec & labeling: sam + labelops-bot
- eval harness + metrics: alex + infra-bot
- quant runtime knobs: kai + eng-runtime

mira: timeline: sample seeds today, dedupe + 2k selection tomorrow, labeling starts tomorrow evening, harness runs after 50% gold done (expected T+3).

sam: I'll post the annotator doc and example guidance in #eng-ml later today.

alex: infra-bot: can you reserve a staging fleet for the canary runs (2 GPUs 8h/day) next week?

infra-bot: Reserved: staging-q8b-int3-caniary (2xA100) for 2026-03-25 -> 2026-03-29, 08:00-16:00 PT.

mira: Thanks. Any obvious missing pieces?

jordan: Add a tiny automatic regression scorer that samples N=100 from golden and runs locally to surface catastrophic regressions before full harness. Quick sanity.

mira: love that. Ok team — let's sync tomorrow 09:30 PT if anything blocks. :calendar: 

sam: ack, will have the golden template + 10 seed examples by EOD.

kai: ack, starting dedupe run now. I'll post progress snippets here. :mag:
